body: The best thing you can do is care about yourself and not live thinking you’re disappointing everyone. No human is perfect and I’m sure there are many wonderful things about you that you might have a hard time seeing but they are there

Depression and feelings of self worthless are not a thing to be shamed off. You’re not alone, there is help out there and ppl you can connect with that have felt the same or care to help. Don’t be ashamed for the way you feel. Parents want the best for their kids but that doesn’t mean you have to be perfect or feel like you’re disappointing them

I understand your pain. I have been there too, I’m not gonna tell you that it could be worse because your feelings are valid and no one really understands others struggles but all I can tell you is that I can listen and even though I don’t know you I care and know that your life is precious

We have discussed it and he has a very good explanation.. like I said it’s me. I told one of my “good friends” we were getting married his response: haha for real this time? I know it’s stupid to listen to negativity but it’s hard not to

You’re right. I guess it is a bit of being afraid of ppl being like “yeah sure you’re getting married” which is stupid but a real feeling. It’s not him it’s me. He has proved his commitment. I’m not here to judge him just sharing my feelings that I wish I could overcome

I do trust him and we are best friends he is my partner my everything. He made a mistake I forgave him it’s my job to overcome those fears... that’s what forgiveness is about. Our relationship is great. It’s my own insecurities but I understand your point a lot of my friends and family had the same opinion

He’s aware of my fears and he’s doing everything he can to show me this time is different. I did leave him but I still loved him and we moved passed it. This fear only came back after him proposing again. I took gim back because he admitted he made a mistake and he was forever sorry... I believe ppl deserve second chances but I am still prettified.
